# EWork desktop integration

Vendored unmodified public JavaScript exports and metadata from @ework/dsh-computer-use 0.1.0. Archive SHA-256: 066d1c5e003a5e4776d322aff58cce74ffff0c4a2cda4de7eb6d7033adc73c9b. Source: ework-dsh-plugins commit 9fdeb9643fa8bf8b08d69b3a096ed0e25531c672.

The desktop lifecycle adapter supplies the signed host's pinned 0.28.2 native executable, so the duplicate 53 MB executable is intentionally omitted. The SDK dependency is declared by dsh-integration-runtime. Plugin code, tool name, arbitration and background-only behavior are unchanged. This folder is not a standalone redistributable plugin archive.
